note: Pre-marked with Vonk's picks; Al changed what he disagreed with.

pairs.line: The sun has no indoor voice.

af.proposal: Die son het net een volume: hard.

pairs.line: The tar's gone soft. So have we.

af.proposal: Die teer het sag geword. Ons ook.

pairs.line: The wind took the washing. It's keeping the pegs.

af.proposal: Die wind het die wasgoed gevat. Die knypers mag ons maar hou.

pairs.line: Rain this hard, even the taxis start indicating.

af.proposal: Reën só hard, selfs die taxi's sit hul flikkers aan.

pairs.line: The sky's been saying 'just now' for three hours.

af.proposal: Die lug sê nou al drie uur lank 'netnou'.

pairs.line: Thunder that close counts as a house guest.

af.proposal: Donder so naby tel as 'n huisgas.

pairs.line: The fog cancelled the Drakensberg. No refunds.

af.proposal: Die mis het die Drakensberg gekanselleer. Geen terugbetalings nie.

pairs.line: Cape cold doesn't knock. It comes in through the walls.

af.proposal: Kaapse koue klop nie. Dit kom sommer deur die mure in.

pairs.line: Blue sky, minus two. The sun's just here to watch.

af.proposal: Blou lug, minus twee. Die son is net hier om te kyk.

pairs.line: Karoo sky. You'll count to forty and give up.

af.proposal: Karoo-lug. Jy tel tot veertig en gee op.

loved.en: The clouds are holding a meeting. Could go either way.

af.proposal: Die wolke hou 'n vergadering. Kan enige kant toe gaan.

loved.en: Highveld clouds this heavy by two o'clock don't bluff.

af.proposal: Hoëveldse wolke wat teen twee-uur al so swaar is, bluf nie.

loved.en: Might rain. I've already cancelled everything, just in case.

af.proposal: Dalk reën. Ek het klaar alles gekanselleer, net vir ingeval.

loved.en: The sky just said something. Nobody's arguing.

af.proposal: Die lug het nou net iets gesê. Niemand stry nie.

loved.en: Hail. Every car owner in Gauteng just stood up.

af.proposal: Hael. Elke kareienaar in Gauteng het pas opgestaan.

loved.en: The sky is throwing ice. Honestly, it feels personal.

af.proposal: Die lug gooi ys. Eerlikwaar, dit voel persoonlik.

loved.en: UV this high, and even the shade wants shade.

af.proposal: UV so hoog, selfs die skadu soek skadu.

loved.en: The sun's working overtime today, and billing your nose.

af.proposal: Die son werk vandag oortyd, en jou neus kry die rekening.

loved.en: Barefoot to the car is an extreme sport today.

af.proposal: Kaalvoet kar toe is vandag 'n ekstreme sport.

loved.en: The wind has opinions and it's sharing every one.

af.proposal: Die wind het opinies en deel elkeen.

loved.en: Bright sun, frozen fingers. The sun's here for decoration.

af.proposal: Helder son, bevrore vingers. Die son is net vir die mooi hier.

other: The reason i rejected the first image is because it is for a clear day, that image feels like it is for extreme heat. Plus it looks a bit like a shack, and the guy seems to be in blue collar worker clothes. And its on a sunday. We want images that are more aspirational in terms of settings.
